data_status: PROTOTYPE - placeholder inputs, not validated results (temporary ET0)

rotations.name: Current rotation (baseline: alfalfa stand)

stress_test.note: Shown beside the ranking; not part of the overall score

explanations: Current rotation (baseline: alfalfa stand): its biggest contribution to the overall score comes from soil-health potential.
Its weakest area is water suitability (score 40.7), which needs local review.
Needs about 724 mm of irrigation per year; usable rain covers about 72 mm.
About 48.7 heat-stress days per year across its growing seasons.
Roughly 5.8 months per year without living green cover.
Stress test (-20% rain, +1.5 C): its overall score is 56.2 (rank 1, baseline rank 1).

reasons: Evapotranspiration (ET0) is a TEMPORARY estimate, not NASA-derived
Crop coefficients, heat limits and soil ratings are not yet verified by a human
Soil properties (SoilGrids) are not used in the scores yet
Water supply (1,220 mm) and effective-rain method are unverified assumptions

Frost risk and soil salinity are not modelled
